about_the_game:
In the Harrowlight Demo, you're inserted into Waymouth and are tasked with a fraction of Grace's role; to meet up and find the Waymouth Marshal.

The demo is just a small taste of a larger area where you must traverse a dangerous landscape to complete your objective.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages. It includes mature content, violence against humanoids.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5 4690
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

Recommended:

short_description: Harrowlight is a third-person survival horror that combines a survival horror experience with exploration in an encapsulating story. Join Grace Cooper, a 'Marshal' for the city of Harrowgate, tasked with extracting a key scientific figure from the town of Waymouth.
